The operating example below is invented teaching data. It is not this location’s revenue, price, occupancy or performance.

INTERACTIVE OPERATING EXAMPLE

Change the activity.
See what remains.

All inputs are adjustable assumptions. The calculation covers one 30-day month and does not calculate an investor return.

What this example includes

Energy = daily sessions × energy per session × 30 days. Receipts = energy × charging price. Electricity cost = energy × electricity price. Other costs represent an assumed combined allowance for site expenses, maintenance and equipment wear.

Demand charges, payment fees, financing, tax, capital expenditure and distribution rules are not modeled separately. Real costs require operator records. The unverified 43% interest and weekly plan rates are not applied.
